title: x-herald /v1/models response (v1, complete)
description: JSON Schema for the OpenAI-compatible model catalogue returned by x-herald's GET /v1/models endpoint. Naming is snake_case throughout. Extensions should keep the OpenAI standard envelope (id/object/created/owned_by) and add per-model metadata under context_window, max_output_tokens, capabilities, cost, headers, thinking_level_map, and compat.

object.description: OpenAI standard envelope discriminator. Always 'list' for this endpoint.

Model.description: One model advertised by the gateway.

id.description: OpenAI standard. Stable identifier passed back in chat completion `model`.

name.description: Display name. Optional; pi falls back to `id` when absent.

created.description: OpenAI standard. Unix timestamp (seconds) of model creation/release.

context_window.description: Maximum input context window in tokens. Required. pi uses this to size the compaction threshold.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response. Required. 0 means unlimited (no output cap); consumers should map it to floor(context_window / 2) because most LLM SDKs require a positive value. Maps to pi's maxTokens.

context_length.description: OpenAI-standard fallback some gateways emit in place of context_window. Consumers should read context_window first, then this.

headers.description: Per-model static headers appended to every request. Values are literal strings or pi's $ENV_VAR / ${ENV_VAR} references.

contextWindow.description: camelCase mirror of context_window, emitted by newer gateway versions (pi/omp-compat projection). Same value; consumers should read context_window first.

maxTokens.description: camelCase mirror of max_output_tokens, emitted by newer gateway versions. Same value; consumers should read max_output_tokens first.

reasoning.description: camelCase mirror of capabilities.reasoning, emitted by newer gateway versions. Same value.

input.description: camelCase mirror of capabilities.vision, emitted by newer gateway versions as the derived input-mode list. ['text','image'] when vision is on.

maxTokensField.description: camelCase mirror of compat.max_tokens_field, emitted by newer gateway versions. Same value.

mediaInput.description: 媒体输入约束，透传路由目标实例 metadata.mediaInput（无实例配置时省略）。

Capabilities.description: Boolean capability flags. Closed set; missing key implies false. Extend by adding a new boolean property here when needed.

streaming.description: Gateway can stream tokens via SSE.

vision.description: Model accepts image input. Maps to pi's input: ['text','image'].

reasoning.description: Model supports extended thinking. Maps to pi's reasoning: true.

Cost.description: Pricing per million tokens. snake_case for consistency with the rest of the schema. Tiered pricing (e.g., GPT-5.6 short/long-context switch) lives under `tiers`.

cache_read.description: USD per 1M cached input tokens read.

cache_write.description: USD per 1M cached input tokens written.

tiers.description: Ordered list of alternate rate sets. Each tier REPLACES the base rates for the entire request once total input usage (input + cache_read + cache_write) exceeds the tier's `input_tokens_above`. When multiple tiers match, the one with the highest `input_tokens_above` wins.

CostTier.description: A complete alternate rate set triggered by total input tokens above a threshold.

input_tokens_above.description: Total input tokens (input + cache_read + cache_write) at or above which this tier applies.

input.description: USD per 1M input tokens under this tier.

output.description: USD per 1M output tokens under this tier.

cache_read.description: Optional. USD per 1M cache-read tokens under this tier.

cache_write.description: Optional. USD per 1M cache-write tokens under this tier.

ThinkingLevelMap.description: Maps pi's thinking levels to provider-specific values. Each level is either a string the provider accepts, or null to hide that level from the model's thinking picker. Strict set; unknown levels are rejected.

Compat.description: Provider-specific compatibility overrides. Mirrors pi's `ProviderModelConfig.compat`. Field names use snake_case; values are forwarded as-is to pi.

additionalProperties.description: Ad-hoc compat flag (forwards-compatible). pi ignores keys it does not recognize.

openrouter_routing.description: Forwarded verbatim into OpenRouter's `provider` routing field.

vercel_gateway_routing.description: Forwarded verbatim into Vercel AI Gateway's `provider` routing config.
